newsitem.title: USA: AEP unit looks for Canada power ventures.
newsitem.headline: AEP unit looks for Canada power ventures.

text.p: American Electric Power said Monday a company subsidiary contracted a representative to look for opportunities in the Canadian energy market.
"We hope to participate in discussions about the structure of the North American energy industry," Donald Clements, president of AEP Resources, said in a statement.
"We are also interested in cogeneration opportunities, independent power production and other areas," Clements said.
Tom Drolet, a former Ontario Hydro employee, will represent AEP Resources in Canada, the company said.
